notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE TO LUNAR MOUNTAIN
notes.content:
Attention all Lunar Mountain players! We are excited to announce that the latest update has fixed all known bugs in the game and added steam achievements for even more fun and challenges.

We understand the importance of a smooth gaming experience and have worked tirelessly to ensure that all issues have been resolved. You can now enjoy Lunar Mountain without any interruptions or glitches.

In addition, we have added steam achievements that will keep you engaged and entertained for even longer. 


Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the latest update to Lunar Mountain. Happy gaming!


Pixel Playground Team
